slides.title: Gang-Aware Preemption
slides.source: Illustrative six-job scenario. Each two-Pod training gang stays inside one HyperNode. Four scattered victim Pods interrupt four West jobs; gangs A and B release the same four slots. Priority-ordered gang candidates are simulated within the preemptor domain before committing. Based on gangpreempt.go and actions/utils/bundle.go and simulate.go; not a scheduler benchmark result.

slides.source: v1.17 roadmap #6166. Selected directions for this session, not an official priority ranking: PodGroup-level resource defragmentation #3948; HyperNode extender #6028 and SubGroup affinity #5347; generic xPU topology #5751 and DRA/DRANET integration; ecosystem expansion.
